item.title: Ubisoft Has Reportedly Stopped Sharing Game Sales Data
item.description: Ubisoft has reportedly stopped sharing its game sales data, as confirmed by industry analyst Mat Piscatella.

item.title: Clair Obscur Expedition 33 Surpassed Elden Ring as Most Awarded Game Of All Time with Wccftech GOTY
item.description: With the 2025 Wccftech Awards GOTY, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 surpassed Elden Ring as the most awarded game of all time.

item.title: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined producer Takeshi Ichikawa discusses remaking a genre classic
item.description: It feels like 2026 has only just started, yet we've already seen big RPG releases with several more on the way in the coming weeks. One of the most notable games is Dragon Quest VII Reimagined, a rare 2nd remake of a classic title seeing wide release on consoles and Steam twenty-five years after its original debut on PlayStation.

item.title: Nioh 3 Video Showcases 17 Minutes of Gameplay
item.description: Publisher Koei Tecmo and developer Team Ninja have released the gameplay showcase video for the dark Sengoku action RPG, Nioh 3, that features over 17 minutes of gameplay footage.

item.title: NORSE: Oath of Blood is coming to PC on Feb 17th, and consoles in Spring
item.description: "Arctic Hazard and Tripwire today announced that their Viking-era turn-based tactical game, NORSE: Oath of Blood, is coming to PC on Feb 17th, and consoles in Spring" - Arctic Hazard and Tripwire.

item.title: Leak Offers New Look At Character Design In Canceled Prince Of Persia: The Sands Of Time Remake
item.description: A new leaked image offers a fresh look at the character design of the prince in Ubisoft's canceled Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time remake.

item.title: Resident Evil - Code: Veronica Remake Is Allegedly Targeting Release In The First Half Of 2027
item.description: The often rumored remake of Capcom's Resident Evil - Code: Veronica is allegedly targeting a release in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Quarantine Zombies Gameplay Video
item.description: Skewed and Reviewed have posted some gameplay of the pending Zombie hybrid that has players screen survivors, craft, and deal with Zombies.
